raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Some transactions, apparently from recent batches, carry unpadded customer_ids such as 'C8' and 'C110', while the customer dimension uses 5-digit padded ids like 'C00008'. The inner join in gold_region_daily drops those rows (4582 vs 4248), and gold_customer_spend splits one customer into two keys. Normalizing the id format in silver_transactions fixes both.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(customer_id, '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
